selection: Search all repository issues created in period; then retain User-authored titles starting exactly Bug:. Do not select by current labels, outcome or presence of clarification.
coding_status: Assistant-coded from retained comment text; reproducible evidence, not independent human annotation. User account type does not prove unaided human authorship.
extension_rule: No extension for this measurement. Any later extension must be predefined and reported separately, retaining this result.
source_caveats: Retrieval-time public search and timeline data; deleted or converted issues may be absent.
Edited/deleted comments may differ from their historical text; creation timestamps alone do not reconstruct original wording.
Bug: title-prefix proxy can miss differently titled reports; current titles may have changed.
Seven-day window excludes later requests. No code reproduction or original-report-completeness judgement is inferred.
First response time is elapsed time, not maintainer labour or time saved.
